description: Backend-logic items 1, 2 and 4. (1) Allow a user to enroll in a private/draft course they themselves created. (2) Let catalog search match on the creator's profile name. (4) Do NOT award XP for a question the user has already answered correctly in a prior finalized attempt (anti-regrind). Each needs a server (SQL/RLS) change delivered as a NEW migration PLUS the matching client change. The server is authoritative; add migrations, do not edit the generated src/types/database.ts.
steps: ITEM 1 (enroll in own course): Add a NEW migration supabase/migrations/0017_enroll_own_course.sql that redefines the enrollments INSERT RLS policy. Current policy enrollments_insert_own (in 0011_rls_policies.sql) only permits enrolling in courses where status='published' AND visibility='public'. Relax the WITH CHECK so a user may also enroll in a course where courses.creator_id = auth.uid() (their own course, regardless of status/visibility), while still permitting public+published for everyone and keeping user_id = auth.uid(). Drop-if-exists then create the policy so the migration is re-runnable; mirror the existing policy style in 0011. Note in a SQL comment that finalize_attempt (0010) already credits XP for a creator's own course, so this only aligns the explicit enrollment path.

ITEM 1 (client): In src/features/courses/CatalogPage.tsx the 'Criados por mim' (created) tab currently renders CourseCard with no enroll affordance. Add an 'Matricular' action for created courses that are not yet enrolled by the viewer: wire it to the existing handleEnroll(courseId)/useEnroll mutation. Determine enrolled state for created courses too (extend enrolledCourseIds to also reflect created-tab enrollment, or fetch per-card). After enrolling, the course should appear under the user's trail on the dashboard. Keep CourseCard's existing API; if needed add an optional onEnroll/enrolled prop usage for the created tab the same way the 'all' tab uses it. Verify useEnroll already invalidates enrollments + catalog queries (it does).

ITEM 2 (server search by creator name): In src/features/courses/api.ts useCatalog(), the supabase query filters with .or() over title/slug/category/description only. Extend creator-name search. Preferred approach that works with PostgREST: after building the base query, when filters.search is set, ALSO match the embedded creator profile name. Because PostgREST cannot OR across an embedded table in a single .or(), implement it by (a) keeping the existing column .or(), and (b) additionally resolving creator matches: query profiles whose display_name/username ilike the term to get their ids, then broaden the catalog results to include courses whose creator_id is in that set. Implement cleanly: run the two reads and merge/dedupe by course.id, preserving created_at desc ordering and the existing pagination/hasMore contract (CatalogPage merges pages by offset). Keep it server-side (do not fetch the whole table). If a single combined server query is impractical, do the creator-id prefetch then one courses query using .or(title.ilike..., slug..., category..., description..., creator_id.in.(...)). Ensure published+public scoping and category/tag filters still apply.

ITEM 2 (helpers/tests): src/features/courses/helpers.ts buildCatalogPredicate already matches creatorName in its haystack. Add/extend unit tests in src/features/courses/__tests__/helpers.test.ts to assert that a search term matching only the creatorName returns true (accent/case-insensitive), covering the client-refinement contract. Do not change buildCatalogPredicate's behavior unless a bug is found.

ITEM 4 (server anti-regrind): Add a NEW migration supabase/migrations/0018_no_xp_for_already_correct.sql that creates or replaces public.finalize_attempt(uuid) (copy the current definition from 0010_domain_functions.sql verbatim as the base, then modify) so that when grading each answer, if the user has ALREADY answered THIS question correctly in a PRIOR finalized attempt (a different attempt, finished_at not null, is_correct = true, same user via attempts.user_id), the awarded xp for that answer is forced to 0 while is_correct is still recorded truthfully. The per-attempt totals (correct_count/total_count) still reflect correctness; only xp_earned (per-answer and the summed attempt xp that feeds profiles.xp_global / room xp_internal) excludes already-correct questions. Apply this in BOTH course and room branches (the xp sum is computed once before branching, so zeroing at grade time covers both). Preserve all existing behavior: ownership check, idempotency (side effects only on first finalize), completion insert, streak, medals, enrollment boundary. Update the function comment to document the anti-regrind rule. Keep it re-runnable (create or replace).

ITEM 4 (parity note): finalize_attempt is server-authoritative and the client does not recompute XP, so no src/domain change is strictly required. If any client-side display helper claims XP for a repeat, leave the server as the source of truth. Add a short comment in src/features/lesson/api.ts near finalizeAttempt noting that the server may return xpEarned=0 for already-correct questions (anti-regrind) so the UI message '+X XP' naturally reflects it.

Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build after the changes. Use boundary casts (as unknown as X) consistent with the existing api.ts style for any new query shapes; do NOT edit src/types/database.ts.
acceptance_criteria: 0017 migration redefines the enrollments INSERT policy to also allow creator_id = auth.uid(); it is drop-if-exists + create and does not alter other policies.
The catalog 'Criados por mim' tab shows a working Matricular action for a not-yet-enrolled own course, using useEnroll; after enrolling the course shows under Matriculados / dashboard trail.

useCatalog returns courses whose creator display_name/username matches the search term (verified by code review of the merged server query), while still honoring published+public, category and tag filters and the hasMore/nextOffset pagination contract.
New/updated tests in src/features/courses/__tests__/helpers.test.ts assert creator-name search matching and pass.

0018 migration create-or-replaces finalize_attempt so a question previously answered correctly in another finalized attempt awards 0 XP on re-answer, while is_correct and correct_count still reflect correctness; course and room branches both covered; ownership/idempotency/completion/streak/medals/enrollment-boundary logic preserved.
npm run typecheck, npm run test, npm run build pass; npm run lint has 0 errors and no new warnings.
